at: Bidam laughs out loud, in a line
alt: Class 51's first morning: a line of boys on the Hwarang yard; sixteen-year-old Bidam laughs out loud in the back row while round young Alchun holds half a rice cake out to a stiff, straight new boy at the end of the line.
scene: Low three-quarter angle along a line of teenage boys standing on packed earth in the Hwarang yard of Surabol in early morning. Foreground right, out of focus: the shoulder and drumstick of a drum master. Midground, sharp: at the end of the line a fifteen-year-old Yushin stands rigidly straight, dusty boots, chin up, lips pressed, refusing a half rice cake; in front of him, having broken the line, a round-faced fourteen-year-old Alchun in a plain hwarang tunic holds out the half rice cake with a full mouth; in the back row behind them sixteen-year-old Bidam throws his head back laughing out loud, black headband on his brow. All three are BOYS, beardless, young faces. Background: timber yard fence and giwa roofs melting into morning haze. ONE device: the straight line of boys receding diagonally to a vanishing point, broken by Alchun's step out of it. Low sun from the left, long shadows across the earth.

at: He still drops his left shoulder.
alt: Two grown men lean on the Hwarang yard fence among giggling girls: Bidam with his prayer beads, Alchun eating; teenage Bupmin edges along the rail toward them.
scene: Medium-wide over-the-shoulder shot from behind the timber rail of the Hwarang yard fence in late afternoon sun. Out-of-focus foreground: the backs and hair ornaments of two giggling young women in white hanbok. Midground, sharp: two grown men leaning on the rail side by side like boys: Bidam in a dark navy robe, prayer beads looped on his wrist, chin on his forearms, wry smile, eyes on the yard; Alchun beside him, broad, eating a rice cake. To the left along the rail a fifteen-year-old Bupmin in a hwarang tunic with a crescent headband edges toward them, curious, wide-eyed. Background: the dusty yard, a tiny figure of a marshal turning his head toward them, giwa roofs in haze. ONE device: the long horizontal rail cutting the frame. Low raking sun, long shadows of the posts.

alt: At night under the covered gallery, Yushin lifts a lamp toward a painted mural of a young man laughing among raiders at a campfire, and a crowd of new Hwarang turns to stare at Bupmin.
scene: Night, low angle along a long roofed gallery wall at the Hwarang hall. The plaster wall is covered with old painted murals; the nearest panel is bright and fresh: a painted young man in magenta sitting cross-legged at a campfire among laughing raiders, swords on the ground (it is a flat painting on plaster, slightly naive mural style). Yushin, the marshal, bearded, in blue, holds one oil lamp up toward the mural, his face lit from below, the faintest smile. In the midground a crowd of teenage hwarang boys in crescent headbands has turned away from the mural to stare and point at one boy: fifteen-year-old Bupmin in the middle, startled and embarrassed, ears red. ONE device: the long receding wall of murals vanishing into darkness, a single pool of lamplight. Warm lamp gold against ink-black night; out-of-focus foreground timber post.

at: the Marshal walks past himself like a door
alt: Yushin walks past a faded mural of three boys and a tiger on Mount Nam without raising his lamp, while the boys behind him crane to read it.
scene: Night, side view along a roofed gallery wall. On the faded plaster mural: three painted boys and a huge painted tiger on a mountain, one round boy with his arms round the tiger's neck, one with a sword, one with prayer beads (an old flat mural, paint flaking, colours gone soft). In front of the mural, walking past it without looking, Yushin the bearded marshal carries his lamp low at his hip, eyes forward, jaw set, so the mural is lit only at its lower edge. Behind him a line of teenage hwarang boys crane their necks and squint up at the painted tiger, one pointing at him and the painting. ONE device: the lamp held LOW so the light falls in a narrow band across the bottom of the mural. Ink-black upper frame, warm lamp-gold lower band.

at: looks at the arrows for a long time
alt: Bupmin stands alone before an old mural of two young men under a fallen horse, full of arrows, with a small monk writing in the corner.
scene: Night. Close medium shot, over Bupmin's shoulder, of an old painted mural on a plaster wall: two young painted warriors under a fallen horse, many arrows standing in them like reeds, and small in the corner a painted monk writing on a scroll (flat old mural, earth pigments, cracked plaster). Fifteen-year-old Bupmin in a hwarang tunic and crescent headband stands close in the foreground right, his face in three-quarter profile, very still, sober, looking at the arrows. A lamp held by someone off-frame left rakes across the mural surface, picking out the cracks and the painted arrow shafts; his cast shadow climbs the wall. ONE device: his shadow on the mural, overlapping the painted horse. Warm lamp key, crushed black.

at: Yushin sets the lamp down on the ground in front of them.
alt: At the far end of the wall Yushin has set his lamp on the ground before a small faded mural of two boys on a riverbank with a stone, and the new Hwarang sit down in the dark around it.
scene: Night, low wide shot from floor level at the very end of a long roofed gallery, where the painted wall meets an old weathered timber gate. A single oil lamp sits on the packed earth at the foot of the wall. Above it, small and very faded, an old mural of two thirteen-year-old boys on a riverbank, one scratching at a flat grey stone with a knife, the other watching (faint old pigments on grey plaster). Yushin the bearded marshal crouches beside the lamp, forearms on his knees, looking up at the two painted boys. Around him teenage hwarang boys in crescent headbands are sitting down cross-legged in a half circle, faces lit from below. Behind them the long wall recedes into total darkness. ONE device: the lamp on the ground as the only light, a low warm dome in black. Old-master tenebrism.

at: Two cups on the Gaya boy’s side.
alt: In the councillors' row at the spring gyuku match, Bidam and Alchun sit side by side betting cups of wine against each other.
scene: Medium two-shot in the timber stands of the palace gyuku field on a bright spring day. Bidam in a dark navy robe, prayer beads on his wrist, sits upright and dry, holding up two fingers; beside him Alchun, broad, leans back grinning with a lunch box in his lap and two wine cups on the bench between them. Behind them out of focus, rows of nobles in silk and a striped awning. In the background below, the field: tiny riders with sticks and a ball in a cloud of dust. ONE device: the bench rail as a strong diagonal. Bright high-key day, crisp shadows under the awning.

at: Twenty black headbands, and in the middle a mild man
alt: Before dawn, twenty torches block the south road where it crosses the outer ditch; Yumjong stands in the middle leaning on his spear as Yushin rides up on the young grey.
scene: Night before dawn, wide low shot from behind Yushin on horseback: the dark silhouette of a bearded rider on a young grey horse in the out-of-focus foreground. Ahead, a dirt road crossing a dug ditch on a bank, and a line of twenty torches held by rebels in black headbands blocking it. In the middle of the road, alone and sharp, a mild middle-aged nobleman on foot, Yumjong, leaning on a long spear like a walking stick, polite half-bow, black headband. Torch flames reflected in the ditch water. ONE device: the line of torches as a hard horizontal of fire across a black frame. Faint blue pre-dawn on the far hill.

at: something small and grey drops out of it into the ditch
alt: Yumjong's spear thrust tears Yushin's sleeve from wrist to elbow, and a small grey stone falls from it toward the ditch.
scene: Manga action frame, hard dutch angle, low from the mud of the ditch bank at night: Yumjong lunges with a long spear straight across the frame, his mild face suddenly fierce; the spearhead has just ripped Yushin's sleeve open from wrist to elbow, torn cloth flying, and a small smooth grey stone tumbles out of the sleeve in mid-air toward the lens. Yushin, bearded, in a dark blue robe, twists aside with his ring-pommel sword drawn low. Torchlight from behind as orange rim on the spear and the flying cloth. Dry-brush ink speed lines along the thrust, ink-splatter mud. No lettering. ONE device: the spear shaft as the frame's diagonal.

at: winds it round his own wrist, under the beads
alt: Kneeling in the ditch mud among torches, Bidam winds Yumjong's black headband around his wrist under his prayer beads, the dead man across his knees.
scene: Night, intimate close shot at the bottom of a muddy ditch. Bidam, grey-haired, in a dark navy robe soaked with mud, kneels with the dead Yumjong lying across his knees, eyes closed. Bidam is winding a black cloth headband around his own wrist beneath a loop of prayer beads, his face bowed, grief held in, lips moving in a sutra. Around the edge of the frame, out of focus, the legs and torches of standing rebels. Torch fire from above right as the one hard key on Bidam's hands, the beads and the wet cloth; navy #141C2E specular on the beads in the dark. ONE device: the circle of torches as bokeh discs ringing the two men. Old-master tenebrism.

at: Then the Marshal of Silla cries in the road
alt: Alone on the dark road, Yushin sits in the dirt with a stone in his fist and weeps while the young grey horse stands over him with its nose to his chest.
scene: Pre-dawn, low wide shot on an empty dirt road between dark hills. Yushin, bearded, in a dark blue robe with one sleeve torn open, sits in the middle of the road with his knees up, head bowed, one fist clenched around a small stone against his forehead, shoulders shaking. A young grey horse stands over him, head lowered, nose pressed into his chest. No one else. ONE device: the pale road as a long ribbon curving away into blue darkness behind them. One pale break in the cloud low on the horizon as the key, silver on the horse's neck and his wet face. Vast empty dark sky, small figures in the lower third.
